rationale: The original entry premise relied on price holding above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($30.99) and consolidating within the $30.98 to $31.02 range. Since entry, price has broken below both the 9-EMA and the $30.98 support floor—which has now acted as a hard ceiling across five consecutive 1-minute candles—while the latest candle closed at the $30.96 low on expanding volume. Exiting now cuts the position as the immediate technical structure has failed.
